model_annotation: This figure presents three donut charts displaying data on enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021. The charts are divided into four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services. For the number of enterprises, the sectors are industry (8%, 2.4 million), construction (19%, 5.9 million), trade (12%, 3.7 million), and other services (61%, 19.0 million). The number of persons employed is distributed as follows: industry (21%, 6.6 million), construction (19%, 5.9 million), trade (31%, 9.8 million), and other services (51%, 16.0 million). The turnover is divided into industry (33%, 10.6 trillion), construction (6%, 1.9 trillion), trade (31%, 9.9 trillion), and other services (31%, 9.8 trillion). A legend at the bottom of the figure indicates that industry is represented by brown, construction by light blue, trade by red, and other services by dark blue. Each chart includes percentage labels inside the sectors, and no sectors are visually highlighted beyond their standard representation. The sectors appear to be arranged in descending order of size within each chart.
